Very happy with Vito's Pool Service  for upgrading our salt system. From the initial consultation with Vito himself  to the installation by Alan, everyone was top-notch. Vito took his time to explain the best option for us,  clearly explained the best option, the process and the benefits. The installation was seamless. They left the pool pump area clean and even replaced a gauge for us, for free!! The price was great compared to other companies that didnt offer options at all.

Vito’s pool service was great to work with. Our booster pump for our Polaris cleaning robot broke over the weekend and I contacted Vito on Monday. He is very responsive and sent out his technician, Alan, on Tuesday with a replacement pump.
Alan did a great job installing the new booster pump and by Tuesday noon everything was working.
Price and labor was transparent and fair, easy to pay the invoice online as well.
Great service, highly recommend!

I had a great experience with Vito. We had just bought a new house with a pool and I knew nothing about pools. The weather turned freezing and the pool pump wasn’t coming on automatically. I called Vito late at night. I wasn’t a customer, but he helped me anyway and gave me clear direction to get the pump kicked on. We were so relieved. Really Appreciate him taking the time to help us out and his ability to quickly identify the problem and tell us what to do.

Vito's Pool Service is the best!  They provide weekly cleaning service of my pool and always do a excellent, very thorough job.  Recently, my pool filter failed.  I talked to Vito, and he had a replacement filter unit at my property and installed the same day.  The service technicians are always very professional.  Vito's pool service is always honest and fair.  I would eagerly recommend them to anyone needing regular pool service or emergency repairs.

I have had an ongoing valve issue since we owned this pool. It finally came to the point where it needed to be replaced. Due to the configuration, additional valves needed to be replaced. Vito came highly recommended by our neighbor. I contacted him, and he and his team responded immediately. They did a fantastic job replacing the valves with new plumbing. I would not hesitate to use him again

What a difference the new pool equipment made! On 3/14/25, Vito and Alan upgraded my ancient, 27-year-old equipment with a new cartridge filter, efficient variable speed pump, and new plumbing. I was amazed at how quiet the new pump turned out to be! Vito and Alan completed the work in one day and were very good about communicating throughout the project and leaving my backyard in pristine shape. I will definitely call them again.

I highly recommend Vito’s Pool Service.  We had an issue with our filter pump not working and called on a Monday.   Vito and his team was able to provide great customer service that same day and get our equipment running again at a fair price.  If you have any pool equipment issues or need weekly service, look no further than Vito’s Pool Service.

Vito's is the best.  They clean my pool weekly, and if I ever have any questions they are always there to answer.  Fair prices and quick service as well whenever you have an issue.  Give them a try!  You won't be disappointed.

Vito is very responsive, fair and professional. He has always helped us out in a timely manner and professionally explains the issue(s) and the best course of action to take. Always honest and fair, in It’s great to find a company that is so exceptional at what they do.

Both times the work was done on time and on budget.  The pool computer required total rewiring which took some extra work, but Alan was all over it!  System turned on like clockwork today and I couldn’t be happier.  Highly recommended!
Vito came to my house on an emergency call from 10 pm to 3 am. I'm pretty sure no one out there has that type of commitment and services. Best pool services ever. Highly recommend.

If you’re like me and you dig through reviews to try and get a gauge on companies, you can stop right here and just call Vito to sign up. Pricing is great, he doesn’t charge diagnostic fees to come look at issues, doesn’t gouge you when things need to be repaired, and they actually know how to take care of a pool.
